lines.trans: Are these tapes overdue? Be sure to rewind them properly next time.
Hello there. My, what an incredible movie has come out.
They will definitely turn this into a series. So, what brings you in today?
Today is finally the day our own video hits store shelves.
Somehow we just couldn't sit still waiting at the office.
Oh, it's out on the rack. Go take a look.
Where could it be — let's see, over this way?
No, not up that high. Lower — way lower.
Then keep going all the way over to the far right.
To the right, right...
Is this single copy all you have?
Yep, that's it.

examples.text: 延滞してないですか？次からちゃんと巻き戻しといてね。
examples.trans: Are these tapes overdue? Be sure to rewind them properly next time.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.
Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.
Used with の to modify the following noun (次のお二人様, 次の駅).

examples.trans: I get off at the next station.

meanings.note: Follows a clause to give a reason or reassuring explanation.

examples.trans: Because it is close, I walk.

meanings.note: Reassures that rules or steps are followed properly.

examples.text: ちゃんと確認しました。
ちゃんと並んでいます。
延滞してないですか？次からちゃんと巻き戻しといてね。
examples.trans: Are these tapes overdue? Be sure to rewind them properly next time.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
Conversational interjection.

examples.trans: Oh dear, we're in a bind.

meanings.note: Plain い-adjective.

examples.text: 彼の英語は本当にすごい。

meanings.note: Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Standalone pronoun ('this'), unlike この which requires a noun.

examples.text: これ間違いなくシリーズ化するだろうね。で、今日何の用？
examples.trans: They will definitely turn this into a series. So, what brings you in today?

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Special reading きょう.
Read なん before だ/です/の, and なに before が/を or alone.

examples.text: 何を買いにきましたか。
examples.trans: What did you come to buy?

meanings.note: Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Core noun for any retail shop or café; often takes polite お to become お店.

examples.trans: There is a shop in front of the station.

meanings.note: In 頭が切れる, means 'sharp-minded / clever'.

examples.text: ついにうちの作品が店頭に並ぶ日なんで。
examples.trans: Today is finally the day our own video hits store shelves.
Oh, hello — your new tapes are lined up on the rack.

meanings.note: Everyday spoken counterpart of なぜ or どうして.

examples.text: なんで知っているんですか。

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Godan verb; in 役に立つ, means 'to be useful'.

examples.text: ここに立ってください。
この経験はきっと役に立ちます。
examples.trans: This experience will surely be useful.

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).
Attaches to the irrealis (a-stem) of godan verbs.

examples.trans: I was called by the teacher.

meanings.note: Signals recognizing someone ('Oh, Toshi!') or letting out a feeling ('Man, I'm hungry').

meanings.en: exist; be available; remain in place
meanings.note: Used for inanimate things and abstract concepts; after て-form (書いてある, 置いてある) describes a resulting state left in place.

examples.text: 名前が書いてあります。

meanings.note: Ichidan verb: blunt imperative 見ろ ('look!') is rough command speech.
Subsidiary ichidan verb written in hiragana after て-form (～てみる).

examples.text: 一度食べてみてください。
やってみなければ分かりません。
examples.trans: You won't know unless you try.

meanings.note: Conditional particle attached to the hypothetical (e) stem of verbs and adjectives.

examples.text: 練習すれば上手になります。
examples.trans: If you practice, you will get better.
If it's cheap, I'll buy it.

meanings.note: Interrogative pronoun for place.
Expresses sudden surprise, shock, or disbelief.

examples.text: えっ、もう帰るんですか。
examples.trans: Huh, are you going home already?

meanings.note: Casual counterpart of こちら.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Softens a refusal or correction at the start of a reply.

そんな.gloss: such; that kind of; that much

meanings.note: Before たくさん, means 'that huge an amount'.

examples.text: そんな話は知りません。
examples.trans: I do not know such a story.

examples.text: そんな高いものは買えません。
examples.trans: I cannot buy something that expensive.

meanings.en: short casual form of じゃあ / では
meanings.note: Brisk spoken transition before taking the next step.
Intensifies the following adverb or verb, as in もっとちゃんと見て.

examples.text: もっと近くで見てください。
もっとゆっくり話してください。

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.note: Limits the preceding noun or phrase to that item alone.

examples.text: これだけお願いします。

meanings.en: in that way; that is so
meanings.note: そうですか ('Is that so? / I see') calmly acknowledges news.

examples.text: そうですか、わかりました。

meanings.note: Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

examples.text: また明日会いましょう。
